staged_patch_note: Downloaded-show whole-page scroll handoff and parent-row suppression are staged in source only. The pinned r22 executable does not contain these new GUI changes; a separately authorized executable build, verified release and updated pin are required before device acceptance. No executable pin was changed by this patch.
note: Only the main executable is taken from this build; every other file comes from the hash-pinned official 21.3 package.
build_note: r22: idempotent iOS audio resume, JSON-RPC schema deferral diagnostics, and the native tab bar owner (Application.cpp loads KodiGlassBar r5 and shows/hides it and runs tab taps from its frame loop, no Python wait). Built and published by kodi-ios-portrait.yml; sha256 is the Kodi binary, checked against the downloaded release. Not yet device-verified.
